fields.label: Mood
fields.options:
AMAZING - I felt wonderful, full of energy and joy
GOOD - I felt good and positive
PRODUCTIVE - I was focused and got things done
AVERAGE - A normal day, nothing special
RELAXED - I felt very and peaceful
EXHAUSTED - I felt very tired and drained
DEPRESSED - I felt down or overwhelmed
BORED - I felt unmotivated or uninterested
SICK - I felt physically unwell or not well
